title: Restricted Hausdorff measure under the similarity y ↦ ξ + t·y
statement: Let N, n ∈ ℕ, ξ ∈ ℝ^N, t > 0 and σ : ℝ^N → ℝ^N, σ(y) := ξ + t·y. Let H^n = μHE[n] be Mathlib's Euclidean-normalized n-dimensional Hausdorff measure on ℝ^N = Euclidean N. Then for every set A ⊆ ℝ^N, measurable or not, H^n⌞σ(A) = t^n·σ_#(H^n⌞A) as measures on ℝ^N. That is, (μHE[n]).restrict (σ '' A) = ENNReal.ofReal (t^n) • ((μHE[n]).restrict A).map σ.
lean_statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (ξ : Euclidean N) (t : ℝ) (A : Set (Euclidean N)), 0 < t → (μHE[n] : Measure (Euclidean N)).restrict ((fun y : Euclidean N ↦ ξ + t • y) '' A) = ENNReal.ofReal (t ^ n) • ((μHE[n] : Measure (Euclidean N)).restrict A).map (fun y : Euclidean N ↦ ξ + t • y)
